summary: CNL Strategic Capital, LLC filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose routine monthly net asset value (NAV) determinations, public offering price adjustments, and declared cash distributions. The board set NAV per share as of July 31, 2026 for six share classes, ranging from $38.91 to $44.91, with total NAV of approximately $1.494 billion. The board also approved new offering prices effective August 31, 2026 and declared monthly distributions per share between $0.083333 and $0.104167. These are ordinary operational updates for a continuously offered non-traded investment vehicle, not special-situation events.
